fields.body:
## Crate Groups

- `crates/memory-api`: shared storage, schema, index, and filesystem primitives.
- `crates/rule-api`: canonical rule manifest, target composition, and generated-target tracking.
- `crates/spec-api`: spec storage, hierarchy, code references, and sections.
- `crates/ticket-api`: ticket graph storage, lifecycle, board, and dependencies.
- `crates/audit-api`: audit records and validation workflows.
fields.title: Crate Groups

fields.body:
## Crate Surface

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Memory[memory-api]
    Rule[rule-api]
    Spec[spec-api]
    Ticket[ticket-api]
    Audit[audit-api]
    CLI[CLI tools]
    MCP[MCP servers]
    HTTP[HTTP services]
    VSCode[ticket-vscode]

    Rule --> Memory
    Spec --> Memory
    Ticket --> Memory
    Audit --> Memory
    CLI --> Rule
    CLI --> Spec
    CLI --> Ticket
    CLI --> Audit
    MCP --> Rule
    MCP --> Spec
    MCP --> Ticket
    MCP --> Audit
    HTTP --> Spec
    HTTP --> Ticket
    VSCode --> Ticket
```

- `crates/memory-api`: storage, filesystem, schema, index, and search primitives shared by the rest of the repo.
- `crates/rule-api`: canonical rule manifests, target composition, and generated-target tracking.
- `crates/spec-api`: specification manifests, sections, tree traversal, and code-reference validation.
- `crates/ticket-api`: tickets, dependencies, board snapshots, ownership, and workflow transitions.
- `crates/audit-api`: audit entities and review-oriented validation flows.

## Tool Use Examples

```bash
cargo run -p rule-cli -- sync-targets --config memory-viewers/memory-api/rule-targets.yaml
cargo run -p ticket-cli -- board show
cargo run -p spec-cli -- refs <spec-id> validate
```

- Regenerate the repo README from canonical rule content.
- Inspect the current ticket board from the CLI.
- Validate a spec's code references before review.

## Tool Use Examples

```bash
cargo run -p rule-cli -- sync-targets --config memory-viewers/memory-api/rule-targets.yaml
cargo run -p ticket-cli -- board show
cargo run -p spec-cli -- refs <spec-id> validate
cargo run -p audit-cli -- help
```

- Regenerate the repo README from canonical rule content managed by `rule-api`.
- Inspect active board state through the `ticket-api` command surface.
- Validate a specification's code references through `spec-api` tooling.
- Discover the available review and audit flows exposed by `audit-api`.
